notes: «عكرمة، ومجاهد، وعطاء» are three co-transmitters at one level (alternatives, not consecutive links); the «و» is not part of the surface
«رفع الحديث إلى رسول الله» attributes the report to the Prophet, who is the end of the chain, not a gap
«قال أبو عيسى ...» is the compiler's grading remark, not a route
